input.quote: This Agreement may not be assigned by either party, by operation of law or otherwise, without the prior written consent of the other party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, provided that (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement pursuant to a merger in which Customer is a party and as a result of which the surviving corporation becomes an Affiliate of another bank holding company, bank, savings and loan association or other financial institution having a capital and surplus of at least $100,000,000
input.rationale: Section 22.4 is asymmetric against us on a material term. Our consent-free carve-out is limited to a merger where the surviving corporation becomes an Affiliate of a financial institution with at least $100,000,000 of capital and surplus, so an affiliate transfer, an acquisition or a sale of substantially all assets would need M&I's consent, while M&I may "freely assign" on its own merger, corporate reorganization or asset sale and to any successor to its Data Services division, with no consent gate and no competitor restriction. That fails the fallback's mutual successor-assignment right with a reasonable-consent standard for other assignments. The redline mirrors M&I's carve-out for us (retaining the Section 21.11 conditions) and subjects M&I's assignments to our prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and never to a competitor of ours. No Vendor termination or re-pricing right arises on our change of control: Section 21.11.B obliges M&I to continue Services (the accounts/items volume limits there are untouched commercial terms).

mappings.element: Customer assignment to an affiliate without consent.
Customer assignment to a successor in a merger without consent.
Customer assignment to a successor in an acquisition without consent.
Customer assignment to a successor in a sale of substantially all assets without consent.
No Vendor assignment without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment not to be unreasonably withheld.
No Vendor assignment to a Customer competitor.
No Vendor termination right on Customer's change of control.
mappings.quote: If a Change in Control occurs with respect to Customer, M&I agrees to continue to provide Services under this Agreement

ops.oldText: (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement pursuant to a merger in which Customer is a party and as a result of which the surviving corporation becomes an Affiliate of another bank holding company, bank, savings and loan association or other financial institution having a capital and surplus of at least $100,000,000 so long as the provisions of Section 21.11 are complied with
ops.newText: (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement to an Affiliate of Customer or pursuant to a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of the assets, stock or securities of Customer, so long as the provisions of Section 21.11 are complied with

ops.oldText: (b) M&I may freely assign this Agreement (i) in connection with a merger, corporate reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, stock or securities, or (ii) to any entity which is a successor to the assets or the business of the M&I Data Services division of M&I.
ops.newText: (b) M&I may assign this Agreement only with Customer's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Customer, (i) in connection with a merger, corporate reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, stock or securities, or (ii) to any entity which is a successor to the assets or the business of the M&I Data Services division of M&I.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Two changes to 22.4: our carve-out (a) now mirrors M&I's, covering Affiliates and successors in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets (Section 21.11 conditions retained); and M&I's free-assignment right in (b) becomes subject to our prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and never to a competitor of ours.
proposal.summary: Broaden Customer's assignment carve-out in 22.4 to Affiliates and successors in any merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and subject M&I's assignments to Customer's consent (not unreasonably withheld) with no assignment to a Customer competitor.
